observation.happening: Time-aware dashboard screen showing greeting, recording quick-action, upcoming calendar events, and recent task with engagement metrics
observation.most_important: Home screen layout with sidebar navigation, time-based greeting (こんばんは), and three distinct content areas: quick action, calendar, recent meetings
observation.next_action: User can initiate recording, click into calendar events, or manage task details
anomalies: None visible — layout is clean and intentional

219E.why: Well-balanced dashboard with clear information architecture, calm aesthetic, and thoughtful whitespace. Executes standard home-screen pattern exceptionally—but does not introduce distinctive elements beyond that pattern. Polished and functional but follows established precedent (not innovative).

observation.happening: Dark recording control bar in preparation state, showing elapsed time counter and inline control buttons
observation.most_important: Minimal heads-up display for active recording session — preparation status, 1-second timer, and icon controls for memo, subtitles, and AI assistant
observation.next_action: Wait for recording to complete preparation or interact with memo/subtitles/AI controls
anomalies: None — extremely compact and intentional form factor

2587.why: Exemplary compact control bar: icon-first design, dark background minimizes distraction, recording state is unmistakable (red dot, timer), and controls are efficiently spaced. Craft is high; execution is flawless for its form factor. However, the pattern (floating recording HUD) is well-established, not novel.

observation.happening: Empty state for Meetings tab in a library—tab navigation, prominent empty message, centered CTA button, and feature capability list
observation.most_important: Thoughtfully designed onboarding empty state that explains both the absence (no meetings recorded yet) and the value proposition (what recordings will unlock). Feature list uses consistent icon treatment.
observation.next_action: Click 'Start recording' button or navigate to Files tab
anomalies: None — empty state is welcoming and actionable

2616.why: Exemplary empty-state design: clear visual hierarchy, ample breathing room, onboarding that explains both 'why it's empty' and 'why you should fill it'. Three-feature list is concise and benefit-focused. However, this follows established empty-state patterns (not a novel approach).

observation.happening: Modal settings dialog for configuring a new recording session before capture begins
observation.most_important: Pre-recording configuration modal with five form fields (microphone, screen audio toggle, template dropdown, save location, project assignment) and two action buttons
observation.next_action: Adjust any settings or click 'Start recording' to begin capture with these parameters
anomalies: None — form is well-organized and state of each control is clear

2659.why: Clean, functional settings modal with clear label-control associations, appropriate spacing, and obvious button affordances (cancel/primary action). No clutter or confusion. Standard form pattern—well executed but not distinctive.

observation.happening: Dark error/alert notification banner indicating task send failure with retry affordance
observation.most_important: Alert communicates a specific failure (send stopped, reply was cut off) with actionable recovery ('Retry'). Title is task name; subtitle explains the error condition.
observation.next_action: Click 'Retry' to attempt send again or dismiss notification with close button
anomalies: Error message 'returned reply was cut off' is somewhat vague about the root cause—could be clearer (network? timeout? service issue?)

2B00.why: Well-designed error notification: clear title, actionable button, close affordance. Warning color appropriately signals issue. Slightly lower calmness due to alert nature, but that is contextually correct. Follows standard notification UX pattern—solid but not distinctive.
